analysis_md:
有题设可知：$y\,dz+z\,dy=\frac{1}{1+(xz)^2}(x\,dz+z\,dx)$

$\frac{y+y(xz)^2-x}{1+(xz)^2}\,dz=\frac{z}{1+(xz)^2}\,dx-z\,dy$

可得：$\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}=\frac{z}{y+y(xz)^2-x}$
